entries.shape: posts on BOTH sides, both slots populated
entries.probe:
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM (
				SELECT side_at_post_time FROM comments c JOIN markets m ON m.id = c.market_id
				WHERE m.slug = 'sp-m2-active' AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL
				GROUP BY side_at_post_time HAVING count(*) > 0
			) s HAVING count(*) = 2
entries.look: both YES and NO columns carry posts

entries.shape: LATEST_INTERLEAVE_INTERVAL + 2 posts — the interleave fires twice
entries.probe:
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM comments c JOIN markets m ON m.id = c.market_id
			 WHERE m.slug = 'sp-m2-active' AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL
entries.look: scroll the post list — a newest-post injection lands after every 10 ranked

entries.shape: one post dominating EACH of Most Debated / Highest Stakes / Contested
entries.probe: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM comments WHERE body LIKE '%attracts the most replies on M2%'
entries.look: three badges, one per lane: M2-P2 Most Debated, M2-P3 Highest Stakes, M2-P4 Contested

entries.shape: most posts dominating no lane
entries.probe: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM comments WHERE body LIKE '%dominate no lane at all%'
entries.look: 9 of the 12 posts carry NO badge — that is the criterion, not an omission

entries.shape: a post with many replies on both sides
entries.probe: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM comments WHERE body LIKE '%attracts the most replies on M2%'
entries.look: M2-P2 — ReplySplitBar, the expand affordance, and stake ordering within each side

entries.shape: a post with zero replies

entries.shape: a post with an attached image
entries.probe: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM comments WHERE image_uploads_id IS NOT NULL

entries.shape: a post long enough to truncate

entries.shape: a removed post with SURVIVING replies
entries.probe:
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM mod_actions ma
			 JOIN comments c ON c.id = ma.target_comment_id
			 WHERE ma.reason = 'content_removed' AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL
entries.look: M2-P8 — the post body is masked; its two replies are still readable

entries.shape: a removed reply under a present post
entries.probe:
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM mod_actions ma
			 JOIN comments c ON c.id = ma.target_comment_id
			 WHERE ma.reason = 'content_removed' AND c.parent_comment_id IS NOT NULL
entries.look: M2-P9's reply — the reply-level masked variant, parent untouched

entries.shape: enough price movement for a multi-point chart with post nodes
entries.probe:
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM (
				SELECT DISTINCT b.price_at_bet FROM bets b JOIN markets m ON m.id = b.market_id
				WHERE m.slug = 'sp-m2-active'
			) p HAVING count(*) > 4
entries.look: the market chart carries multiple points with post nodes on it

entries.shape: an open sellable position
entries.probe:
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM positions p JOIN markets m ON m.id = p.market_id
			 WHERE p.quantity > 0 AND m.status = 'Open'
entries.look: the Sell affordance renders on an Open market's holding

entries.shape: a position on a TERMINAL market
entries.probe:
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM positions p JOIN markets m ON m.id = p.market_id
			 WHERE p.quantity > 0 AND m.status IN ('Closed','Resolving','Resolved','Voided')
entries.look: Sell is HIDDEN, not disabled — M5 is Closed

entries.shape: a settled position post-resolution
entries.probe: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM payout_events
entries.look: P-owner's M7 row — net P/L on the winning side

entries.shape: a viewer holding YES on M2 — the opposite-slot rule
entries.probe:
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM positions p
			 JOIN markets m ON m.id = p.market_id
			 JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
			 WHERE m.slug = 'sp-m2-active' AND p.side = 'YES' AND p.quantity > 0
			   AND u.pseudonym = 'RedFox000'
entries.look: signed in AS P-owner, the NO composer renders oppositeHeld-disabled

entries.shape: audit feed paginates
entries.reason: Audit-feed pagination — AUDIT_FEED_DEFAULT_LIMIT = 200 and the page hard-codes its own ROW_LIMIT with no wiring to reach it. A PRODUCT gap, not a data gap (manifest §3, v1.2 B3)
